GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly, shifted out abruptly, bumped & becoming unbalanced. Near the 1300m, steadied from heels. Over-raced near the 1100m & in middle stages. Held up approaching h/turn. A post-race vet exam revealed no ab. When quest, Rdr & Tnr stated mare after beginning awkwardly & losing ground, was obliged to race further back than anticipated, which resulted in mare over-racing, proving detrimental to its finishing effort. Tnr added mare would be better suited when able to race in a forward position.
